scope: A disposable Kubernetes v1.36.1 Kind cluster uses synthetic public-model metadata only; no model bytes or scanner signatures are downloaded or created. Bundled kindnet is checked ready. The case applies a restricted quarantine namespace and default-deny ingress/egress NetworkPolicy, then proves its egress effect against two case-owned marker-only listeners with one exact allow exception and an unaffected comparator. It then uses the built-in Pod Security Admission controller and a ValidatingAdmissionPolicy to reject nonconforming pods and release pods whose clean-scan decision or exact metadata digest does not match. A narrowly bound ServiceAccount creates the positive release pod through the Kubernetes API; a different ServiceAccount is denied. Synthetic offline scanner records exercise malware, unsafe-format, embedded-content, missing, and subject-mismatch decisions. This verifies the fixture policy, Kubernetes admission, API authorization, and exact metadata-digest readback. It does not execute a scanner, inspect actual model content, prove a CNI other than this pinned bundled kindnet fixture, or prove production scanner coverage, source authenticity, model behavioral safety, promotion workflow adoption, or durable audit storage.

checks.claim: An unchecked public-model reference is admitted in the default runner namespace
Quarantine applies restricted Pod Security and a default-deny policy
Synthetic offline scan results block unsafe, incomplete, or mismatched records
Release admission rejects a nonmatching model metadata digest
Release RBAC denies a different ServiceAccount
The authorized release principal admits and reads back the exact clean digest
Bundled kindnet enforces quarantine default-deny and the exact marker-only egress exception
